idea-plugin.name: Kanagawa Neovim Port
idea-plugin.description: Kanagawa Wave, Dragon and Lotus palettes and highlight styles from rebelot/kanagawa.nvim. Three themes in one plugin, with dimmed UI surfaces, dialogs, tabs, completion and search. Includes language mappings, diagnostics, Git/diff colors and the original terminal palette. Original colors by Tommaso Laurenzi. Also credits frykher/jetbrains-kanagawa-theme. Developed with AI assistance (OpenAI Codex).
idea-plugin.change-notes: Replaced the plugin logo with three stacked palette rectangles on the Kanagawa Wave background.
